import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_51/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_51/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect loaded data (optional, can be commented out)
    # print(df_students.head())
    # print(df_schools.head())
    
    # The target schema requires joining student info with school info.
    # Source0 has student details including school_name but no school ID or school attributes.
    # Source1 has school details including School ID, school_name, type, size, budget.
    # Join on 'school_name' to bring school info into student records.
    
    # Before join, ensure school_name columns have consistent formatting (strip spaces)
    df_students['school_name'] = df_students['school_name'].str.strip()
    df_schools['school_name'] = df_schools['school_name'].str.strip()
    
    # Perform left join of students with schools on school_name
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_students, df_schools, on='school_name', how='left', validate='many_to_one')
    # validate='many_to_one' because many students per school, one school record per school_name
    
    # Rename columns to match target schema exactly
    # Target schema: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
    #                 'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    # The merge should already have these columns, just ensure order and types
    
    # Reorder columns to target schema order
    target_columns = ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
                      'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]
    
    # Enforce data types as per target schema
    df_target['Student ID'] = df_target['Student ID'].astype(int)
    df_target['student_name'] = df_target['student_name'].astype(str)
    df_target['gender'] = df_target['gender'].astype(str)
    df_target['grade'] = df_target['grade'].astype(str)
    df_target['school_name'] = df_target['school_name'].astype(str)
    df_target['reading_score'] = df_target['reading_score'].astype(int)
    df_target['math_score'] = df_target['math_score'].astype(int)
    df_target['School ID'] = df_target['School ID'].astype(int)
    df_target['type'] = df_target['type'].astype(str)
    df_target['size'] = df_target['size'].astype(int)
    df_target['budget'] = df_target['budget'].astype(int)
    
    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_51/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
